encrypted.title: This PDF is password-protected
encrypted.description: Rubrica can't open encrypted PDFs yet. Remove the password with another tool, then try again.

corrupt.title: This file couldn't be read
corrupt.description: The PDF appears to be damaged, or isn't a valid PDF file.

notFound.title: File not found
notFound.description: Rubrica couldn't find this file. It may have been moved or deleted.

unsupported.title: Not supported yet
unsupported.description: This isn't available in this version of Rubrica.

fontMissing.title: Font unavailable
fontMissing.description: The original font isn't available, so Rubrica substituted a standard one.

installFailed.title: Couldn't install the update
installFailed.description: Rubrica will keep using this version. Try again later.
